issues.issue: Did the Federal Court err in allowing Blois's appeal despite non-compliance with the OLCN Appeals Regulation?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue Federal Court erred in allowing Blois's appeal despite OLCN Appeals Regulation non-compliance.
issues.respondent_position: OLCN supports appellants on this argument; Blois opposes appellants on all issues.
issues.result_text: Court did not decide this issue due to mootness and discretion not exercised.

issues.issue: Did the Federal Court err in finding Whitstone engaged in libel and slander violating subsection 5.1(e) of OLCN Election Law?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue Federal Court erred in finding Whitstone engaged in libel and slander violating subsection 5.1(e).
issues.respondent_position: OLCN opposes appellants on this issue; Blois opposes appellants on all issues.
issues.result_text: Court did not decide this issue due to mootness and discretion not exercised.

issues.issue: Did the Federal Court err in finding Whitstone's contravention might have affected the election outcome?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue Federal Court erred in finding Whitstone's contravention might have affected election outcome.
issues.respondent_position: OLCN opposes appellants on this issue; Blois opposes appellants on all issues.
issues.result_text: Court did not decide this issue due to mootness and discretion not exercised.

issues.issue: Should the Court exercise its discretion to hear the moot appeal despite the June 2022 election of a new Council?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants request Court discretion to hear appeal for reputational and financial reasons despite mootness.
issues.respondent_position: OLCN has no strong view on discretion; Blois opposes hearing appeal.
issues.result_text: Court declines to exercise discretion to hear moot appeal; appeal dismissed on that basis.
